issues.legal_issue: The amount a tenant must pay to obtain protection from eviction for rent default includes rent whose recovery is barred by limitation.
material_facts: The landlord sought eviction on the ground that the tenant had failed to pay rent arrears after receiving a demand notice.
The landlord relinquished the claim for rent from an earlier period because its recovery was time-barred.
The tenant deposited the rent and damages claimed for the later period, together with interest and costs, but did not include the earlier unpaid rent.
The tenant relied on the deposit to seek relief from eviction.
issues.conclusion: Time-barred rent forms part of the entire amount of rent due for purposes of the statutory relief. Because the tenant omitted that rent from the deposit, the tenant was not entitled to protection from eviction.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 20(2)(a) and 20(4) of the U.P. Urban Buildings (Regulation of Letting, Rent and Eviction) Act, 1972, a tenant sued for eviction for rent default may obtain relief by unconditionally paying or depositing the entire amount due at the first hearing. A limitation period bars the remedy but does not extinguish the debt, except in circumstances such as those covered by section 28 of the Limitation Act, which do not apply to a debt. The Court relied on Curwen v. Milburn, Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Co. Ltd. v. The State of Bombay, and Ram Nandan Sharma v. Mt. Maya Devi; it also referred to sections 25(3) and 60 of the Contract Act. Accordingly, the entire amount due includes time-barred rent.

rule.if: eviction_suit_for_rent_default and tenant_sought_first_hearing_protection and tenant_had_unpaid_time_barred_rent and tenant_omitted_old_rent_from_deposit

predicates.eviction_suit_for_rent_default: The landlord brought a suit seeking eviction because the tenant had rent arrears and had not paid them after demand.
predicates.tenant_sought_first_hearing_protection: The tenant made a deposit at the first hearing to seek protection from eviction.
predicates.tenant_had_unpaid_time_barred_rent: The tenant had unpaid rent from a period for which recovery by action was barred by limitation.
predicates.tenant_omitted_old_rent_from_deposit: The tenant's deposit did not include the unpaid rent from the time-barred period.
predicates.tenant_not_entitled_to_eviction_protecti: The tenant does not obtain protection from eviction through the statutory deposit procedure.

issues.definition: When an eviction suit for rent default involves a tenant seeking first-hearing protection, unpaid time-barred rent, and a deposit omitting that rent, the tenant does not obtain protection from eviction.
